disclaimer: Grow Room Defense teaches broad integrated pest management concepts through fictionalized game pressure. It does not provide pesticide mixing, application rates, or treatment instructions.

threats.label: Aphid Colony
threats.lesson: Early scouting and biological or sanitation-based IPM responses can help keep small colonies from becoming larger problems.

threats.label: Fungus Gnat Pressure
threats.lesson: Adult monitoring and root-zone moisture management are useful parts of a broader fungus gnat IPM plan.

threats.label: Spider Mite Pressure
threats.lesson: Frequent underside-of-leaf scouting and environmental awareness help catch mite pressure before severe damage develops.

threats.label: Thrips Pressure
threats.lesson: Monitoring cards, close plant inspection, and biological controls can all play roles in thrips IPM.

threats.label: Powdery Mildew Risk
threats.lesson: Canopy airflow, environmental monitoring, and sanitation are important prevention-focused disease-management tools.

threats.label: Botrytis Risk
threats.lesson: Dense, stagnant, humid canopy zones deserve close attention because prevention and early removal of affected material are important disease-management concepts.

threats.label: Shore Fly Pressure
threats.lesson: Persistent surface moisture and organic buildup can support nuisance populations, so monitoring and moisture discipline matter.

threats.label: Unknown Leaf Damage
threats.lesson: Observation should come before diagnosis. Record symptoms, location, progression, and environment before deciding what the problem is.

tools.label: Scout & Inspect
tools.description: Use observation first: inspect plant surfaces, symptom location, and progression before jumping to a diagnosis.

tools.label: Airflow & Spacing
tools.description: Improve canopy air movement and reduce stagnant microclimates as a prevention-focused environmental tactic.

tools.label: Sanitation Reset
tools.description: Remove debris and keep tools and work areas clean to reduce avoidable pest and disease carryover.

tools.label: Monitoring Cards
tools.description: Use monitoring cards as a detection and trend tool for flying pest pressure.

tools.label: Beneficial Predators
tools.description: Represent biological-control organisms matched to a target pest as part of an IPM program.

tools.label: Moisture Management
tools.description: Review irrigation timing and persistent surface moisture rather than treating every root-zone problem as a nutrient problem.

tools.label: Environment Check
tools.description: Review temperature, humidity, airflow, and canopy microclimates for conditions that can amplify pressure.
